title: Implement derived metadata computation
description: Compute byte_count (body_bytes.len()), line_count (body newline count), content_type_summary (top-level Content-Type value extracted from headers, empty string if absent). These feed into the metadata struct. byte_count and line_count match the values that OVER/XOVER return (:bytes, :lines fields per RFC 3977).
notes: Size: S. Depends on Issue C (metadata schema), Issue D (header block builder), and Issue E (body block builder).
